symptom: `create or modify microflow` under `mdl 1;` of a flow whose multi-line free annotation had its CRLF line breaks turned into LF (an editor saving describe's output) was refused: "the free annotations change; the splice edits activities only" — on every run, and the refusal did not say which note. Restoring the CR bytes made it splice (mendixlabs/mxcli#1505). A note on an activity re-spliced that activity for the same reason
cause: declaredMatches compared MicroflowAnnotation.Text byte for byte. Studio Pro stores a note's line breaks as CRLF and describe prints them raw, so the stored side has CR bytes a script saved by an LF editor lacks — invisible on the canvas, a difference to the matcher
file: `mdl/executor/flow_declared_match.go` (matchValue: note Text compared via lfLineBreaks), `mdl/executor/cmd_flow_modify.go` (freeNoteChange names the differing note in the refusal); tests `mdl/executor/flow_declared_match_test.go` (TestDeclaredMatches_NoteLineEndingsAreNotADifference, TestFreeNoteChange_NamesTheNote), `mdl/roundtrip/flow_modify_notes_test.go` (TestSpliceRerun_FreeNoteLineEndings, -tags integration); bug-test `mdl-examples/bug-tests/1505-free-annotation-crlf-splice.mdl` (marked -text in .gitattributes, or git strips the CRs that ARE the case)
insight: **Describe output that holds raw CR bytes does not survive a text editor or git's eol=lf**, so any matcher comparing printed text against stored text must treat line-break spelling as layout, not content. Normalising only in the comparison is enough: a matched note is left as stored, so its CRLF bytes are kept and the run writes nothing. Plausible wrong turn: normalising describe to print LF — that makes describe's output differ from the stored unit and re-splices every Studio Pro note on first run. A refusal that quotes the differing value with strconv.Quote shows an invisible-character difference for what it is (`\r\n` vs `\n`); the bare 'the free annotations change' left the reporter to bisect bytes by hand
